title: Thomas Markle Sr. faces child sex abuse raps --PNP
summary: The Philippine National Police on Wednesday said it has filed criminal charges against Thomas Markle Sr. for alleged child sex abuse.

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday said it has filed criminal charges against Thomas Markle Sr. for alleged child sex abuse.

In a statement, PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Allen Rae Co said the raps are for violations of the Anti-Online Sexual Abuse or Exploitation (OSAEC) and Child Sexual Abuse or Exploitation Materials (CSAEM) Act.
These charges involve the distribution and possession of child sexual abuse or exploitation materials (CSAEM).
The Women and Children Protection Center (WCPC) - Visayas Field Unit filed the complaints before the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday.
Co said the complaints would undergo evaluation and case build-up.
Meanwhile, digital forensic examination of the remaining digital devices seized in connection with the investigation is still ongoing.
"Additional evidence may be submitted in support of the criminal complaints already filed or may be utilized for filing of additional criminal complaints, if warranted," Co said.
Markle, 82, is the biological father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex.
He had stayed in the Philippines for approximately nine to 10 months, beginning in 2025.
Authorities recovered around 7,500 photographs and one video showing underage boys and girls of Asian, Latina, and European descent from devices linked to Markle Sr.
Some of the minors in the recovered materials appeared to be Filipino.
On November 6, Markle was arrested in Florida, United States on a charge of possessing child sexual abuse material. —KG, GMA News
